ART BASEL EXTENDS MIAMI
BEACH STAY THROUGH 2031
Art Basel Miami Beach is set to remain at the Miami Beach Convention Center through at least 2031, following a new long-term agreement approved by the Miami Beach City Commission. The fair could stay through 2033 if it exercises an extension option.

headlines: ART BASEL EXTENDS MIAMI BEACH CONVENTION CENTER STAY THROUGH AT LEAST 2031
ART BASEL IS STAYING IN MIAMI BEACH
A 570 MILLION DOLLAR IMPACT KEEPS ART BASEL IN MIAMI BEACH
items.article:
Art Basel Miami Beach will remain at the Miami Beach Convention Center through at least 2031, following a newly approved agreement by the Miami Beach City Commission. The deal includes an option to stretch the stay through 2033.

The updated contract slashes the fair's annual rental fee from nearly $1 million down to $500,000. Art Basel will provide $100,000 for city transit expenses, and Miami Beach will fund $300,000 in first responder services.

Since arriving in 2002, the fair has fueled our local economy. Last year, around 80,000 visitors delivered an estimated $570 million across Miami-Dade County. The 2026 event runs December 4 to 6 from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily.
